part.name: polygon_cube
part.description: 100 mm cube, one recessed regular-polygon pocket 30 mm deep centred on each of the 6 faces. M001/M002 are user-stated (10 cm / 3 cm). M003..M008 (the six polygon sizes) are PROVISIONAL placeholders chosen to prove the pipeline - replace with real measured values and re-run Phase E->I.

reference.origin_definition: Geometric centre of the cube. Global X, Y, Z each normal to one opposing pair of faces. Each polygon pocket is coaxial with its outward face normal and centred on that face.

measurements.name: cube_edge_length
measurements.measurement_instruction: Overall cube edge. User stated 10 cm.

measurements.name: pocket_depth
measurements.measurement_instruction: Perpendicular depth to the flat pocket floor. User stated 3 cm. Same for all 6 pockets.

measurements.name: tri_face_circumscribed_dia
measurements.measurement_instruction: +X face TRIANGLE pocket: circle through the 3 vertices. PROVISIONAL 36 mm.

measurements.name: square_face_circumscribed_dia
measurements.measurement_instruction: -X face SQUARE pocket: corner-to-corner diagonal. PROVISIONAL 36 mm.

measurements.name: pentagon_face_circumscribed_dia
measurements.measurement_instruction: +Y face PENTAGON pocket: circle through the 5 vertices. PROVISIONAL 36 mm.

measurements.name: hexagon_face_circumscribed_dia
measurements.measurement_instruction: -Y face HEXAGON pocket: across-corners. PROVISIONAL 36 mm.

measurements.name: heptagon_face_circumscribed_dia
measurements.measurement_instruction: +Z face HEPTAGON pocket (assumed 7-gon): circle through the 7 vertices. PROVISIONAL 36 mm.

measurements.name: octagon_face_circumscribed_dia
measurements.measurement_instruction: -Z face OCTAGON pocket (assumed 8-gon): across-corners. PROVISIONAL 36 mm.

constraints.note: Each polygon pocket centred on its face; walls perpendicular, floor flat, no draft/fillet.
Provisional polygon sizes (36 mm) leave a >= 2 mm wall between adjacent-face pockets and a 40 mm web between opposite-face pockets at depth 30 mm.

metadata.notes: M001=100 mm and M002=30 mm are user-stated. M003..M008 = 36 mm are NOT measured and NOT derived from the photo - they are stand-in values so the extended pipeline can be proven end-to-end. Replace with real measurements (see measurement-request.json) and re-run.
